name: CreateOrUpdateAccount
label: Create or Update Salesforce Account
description: Creates a new Account in Salesforce if it doesn't exist, or updates it if it does. Uses Name as the identifier.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Account'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'CreateOrUpdate'.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The name of the Account to create or update (required). Used as lookup key.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields to include when creating or updating the Account (e.g., Industry, Phone, Website).

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Account after creation or update.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after the operation.
